create.title: Create user

detail.title: User
detail.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

activate.title: Activate user?
activate.description: The user will be able to sign in again.

suspend.title: Suspend user?
suspend.description: The user will be temporarily unable to sign in.

deactivate.title: Deactivate user?
deactivate.description: The user will be marked inactive and unable to sign in.

lock.title: Lock user?
lock.description: The user will be locked out until an administrator unlocks the account.

unlock.title: Unlock user?
unlock.description: The user will be restored to active and able to sign in.

archive.title: Archive user?
archive.description: The account will be archived. It can be restored later, but a password reset requires restoring first.

restore.title: Restore user?
restore.description: The account will be restored to active.

security.resetRequiresRestore: This account is archived — restore it before resetting the password.
security.resetUnavailableDeleted: This account is deleted — password reset is not available.
security.resetKeepsStatus: Resetting the password will not reactivate or unlock this account.
security.forceLogoutDescription: This will sign the user out on every device.

roles.title: Roles & Permissions
roles.subtitle: Roles are compiled from Role Templates and shown here read-only.

roleTemplates.title: Role Templates
roleTemplates.subtitle: System templates are immutable; custom templates belong to your company.

form.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

detail.title: Role template
detail.systemImmutable: This is an official system template and cannot be edited or deleted. Clone it to create an editable copy.
detail.archiveConfirmDescription: Archiving preserves all current assignments and compiled access — it is the safe way to retire a template that may still be in use.
detail.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently deletes the template. It is only offered here because it has no current assignments.

apply.title: Apply template version
apply.genericError: The template could not be applied.
apply.scopeWarningTitle: This applies to every current holder
apply.scopeWarningDescription: All holders of this template share one compiled role — applying the current definition updates every one of the {{count}} current holder(s) at once. There is no way to apply this to only some holders.
